summary.text: Keep Careers material lead-only by default, require explicit hiring-change language for Careers candidate promotion, and prevent Careers candidates from becoming structural evidence while preserving non-Careers behavior.

mechanism.text: Use a bounded deterministic Careers signal list after sentence extraction and return no structural dimension for validated Careers evidence; leave the shared non-Careers extractor and classifier unchanged.

affectedComponents.detail: Generic Careers copy remains a pending lead; explicit hiring-change prose can produce a candidate.
Validated Careers candidates remain regular ValidatedFact and never receive a structural dimension.
The Careers boundary and conservative recall behavior are documented without changing commands or report schemas.

designDecisions.decision: Prefer false negatives to promoting generic employer or capability prose.
designDecisions.reason: Careers homepages are source availability and discovery material, not enterprise-change claims.

designDecisions.decision: Keep the Careers rule deterministic, provider-neutral, and narrow.
designDecisions.reason: This Work Item fixes the observed false positive without adding an LLM, provider API, or unbounded synonym expansion.

technicalDetails.detail: After bounded sentence extraction, Careers passages require one of the fixed hiring-change signals before an EvidenceCandidate is emitted.
Validated Careers evidence returns no structural dimension, so it remains a regular ValidatedFact even when broad AI, data, cloud, or infrastructure terms appear.
Non-Careers evidence and report/runtime behavior remain covered by the complete project test suite.

risk.detail: Careers copy varies across providers; deterministic hiring lexicon may prefer false negatives, so paired generic and explicit-hiring fixtures plus non-Careers regression coverage are required.

observedIssues.issue: TDD RED fixtures reproduced the live dry-run boundary failure: generic Careers copy was promoted as a candidate, while an explicit dated hiring change was not recognized because the extractor lacked Careers-specific hiring signals.
observedIssues.resolution: Added paired generic Careers negative and explicit hiring positive fixtures; both failed for the expected pre-implementation reasons before the production gate was changed.

observedIssues.issue: Initial formatting and Clippy checks exposed a multiline test helper formatting mismatch and a needless borrow introduced while adding the Careers fixture.
observedIssues.resolution: Applied cargo fmt and removed the needless borrow; fmt, Clippy with -D warnings, and the complete cargo test suite now pass.

observedIssues.resolution: Rebound the plan, command, and multilingual checks to existing declared Contract, operations-documentation, and evidence-quality test paths; the same Work Item remains in scope for retry.

observedIssues.issue: The third ai-finish retry found one remaining documentationAlignment reference to an undeclared runtime test path.
observedIssues.resolution: Reused the declared evidence-quality test path for the unchanged report/runtime regression claim; no product behavior or scope changed.

observedIssues.resolution: Replaced the duplicate with the declared operations guide path; no report wording, localization, product behavior, or scope changed.

observedIssues.resolution: Added the required technicalDetails evidence to the active Summary; no product behavior or scope changed, and the same Work Item is being retried.
